# Awesome azd catalog-first prototype

> 9 source-linked examples demonstrating template discovery, evaluation and agent retrieval. Not the full Awesome azd catalog or approved contract v1.

Match explicit task and technical constraints with the shared JSON catalog, then retrieve per-template Markdown. Null or unlisted metadata means unknown, not supported. Service tags do not establish the default host. Do not infer price, deployment health, model availability, security or production readiness. Discovery is read-only; review repository hooks and obtain approval before execution or cloud changes.

## Discovery

- [Retrieval guide](agent-guide.md): Facets, matching semantics, provenance and safety.
- [Catalog JSON](templates.json): Only hand-edited record source; schemaVersion design-study-2.
- [Catalog index](index.md): Concise list of all 9 prototype examples.
- [AI collection](templates/ai/index.md): Membership derived from the same records, not another catalog.

## Template details

- [Chat with your documents](templates/azure-samples/azure-search-openai-demo/index.md): Chat with documents; Python, TypeScript; Azure Container Apps.
- [Ask questions of your database](templates/azure-samples/rag-postgres-openai-python/index.md): Query a database; Python; Azure Container Apps.
- [Build a .NET knowledge assistant](templates/azure-samples/azure-search-openai-demo-csharp/index.md): Chat with documents; C# / .NET; Azure Container Apps.
- [Bring document chat to Java](templates/azure-samples/azure-search-openai-demo-java/index.md): Chat with documents; Java; default host unknown.
- [Give your agent new tools](templates/azure-samples/remote-mcp-functions-typescript/index.md): Build an MCP server; TypeScript; Azure Functions.
- [Explore .NET Aspire + Storage](templates/fboucher/aspireazstorage/index.md): Build a web app; C# / .NET; Azure Container Apps.
- [Build your first knowledge agent](templates/azure-samples/get-started-with-ai-agents/index.md): Build an AI agent; Python; Azure Container Apps.
- [Start a Django web app](templates/azure-samples/msdocs-django-postgresql-sample-app/index.md): Build a web app; Python; Azure App Service.
- [Bring your own app with Terraform](templates/azure-samples/azd-starter-terraform/index.md): Start with infrastructure; bring your own code; default host unknown.

## Optional

- [Source initiative](https://github.com/Azure/awesome-azd/issues/1085): Consolidation scope and launch requirements.
- [Upstream production catalog](https://github.com/Azure/awesome-azd/blob/main/website/static/templates.json): The existing source of truth; not replaced by this prototype.
- [llms.txt proposal](https://llmstxt.org/): Discovery guidance, not access control or guaranteed agent support.
